articleTitle: Information Security Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article explores the application of information security risk management methods in enterprises. In the new context of the digital economy the protection of information assets is becoming an important aspect of business. Methods of prevention, forecasting and recognition of information security threats are considered. Preventive measures are proposed to improve information security management processes and reduce damage to enterprises due to weaknesses in existing approaches of risk management.

articleTitle: Barriers in the Integration of Modern Digital Technologies in the System of Quality Management of Enterprises of the Aerospace Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The desire to increase productivity and at the same time reduce production costs has led to the active introduction of automation in all its manifestations. In general, the digitalization of an organization (that is, the introduction of digital technologies) is the process of its transformation, aimed at creating a unified information environment throughout the life cycle of product creation, combining various methods and tools for data management. This article analyzes the problems that exist when integrating modern digital technologies into the quality management system of aerospace enterprises. In general, studies show that the integration of modern digital technologies is a complex process. Many companies in different countries face certain problems in their integration due to different barriers, among which five main ones can be distinguished: violation of employment; high financial costs; security concerns; lack of digital strategy along with lack of resources; problems in ensuring data quality.

articleTitle: Legal Support of Cybersecurity in the Field of Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the modern world, providing cybersecurity has become one of the key tasks of the modern state. This task is included in the general security system of any state. Normative legal acts have appeared recently, which are based on technical regulations and standards. Such regulatory acts include laws and strategic acts about cyber security, cyber threats and countering the use of information weapons. The need to adopt legal acts regulating cybersecurity in all aspects, including the application of artificial intelligence methods, is justified by the rapidly growing number of challenges and threats in the information sphere. The paper discusses the legal support of cybersecurity in Russia in the field of application of artificial intelligence technology.

articleTitle: Legal Regulation of Incidents Related to DDoS Attacks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Now it is not possible to imagine the work of any company without using a connection to local and global networks. This allows you to ensure the expansion of the customer base to a global scale. Failure to operate a company's information system can have disastrous consequences, from theft of insider information to the loss of a customer base. As information technology evolves, attackers also evolve, coming up with increasingly sophisticated attack methods. One of the most common attacks according to statistics is considered a remote network attack. There are various network attacks, but the most dangerous and widespread is the Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS attack). The article describes and analyzes various approaches to combating cybercriminals.

articleTitle: Information Systems and Technologies in Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The key task of the organization's top management is the ability to make adequate and timely management decisions based on the analysis of information about changes in external and internal factors of the organization's environment (context). Management decisions are made by management based on the development of programs to mitigate significant risks and use existing opportunities for business development. All actions of the organization's owners and managers must be aimed at meeting these conditions. The speed of decision-making, the speed of reaction to changing market requirements, the development of an innovative product, and finally, the speed of fulfilling contractual obligations determine the main goal-to increase the competitiveness of the organization. To achieve this goal, it is necessary to solve problems related to the rational organization of information flows of the quality management system and the processing of all information relevant to the context of the organization. Solving these tasks is necessary to achieve effective management. Moreover, it is obvious that the solution of the first task is aimed at solving the second, and here it is necessary to note the predominant role of information systems and technologies that must be integrated into the quality management system (QMS) of the organization.

articleTitle: Application for Traffic Classification Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The timely detection of malicious traffic and the prevention of DDoS attacks is an important task in today's informational environment. There was considered a theoretical part of the classical machine learning algorithms (the principles of their work and the information about parameters). The Functional and non-functional requirements were identified then the action schemes and the use cases were presented. There was developed a traffic classification system appearing as a window application. There was presented the implementation of the classical machine learning algorithms and a user's interface. The developed network traffic identification and classification system uses the machine learning algorithms: k-NN, Naive Bayes, SVM, Ridge / Lasso, Decision Tree and k-Means. The accuracy of the system ranged from 46.69% to 99.81% depending on which algorithm was used.

articleTitle: The Effects of Cyber-security Risks on Added Value of Consulting Services for IT-security Management Systems in Holding Companies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Many efforts in IT-security management systems implementation do not always have the expected results. Sometimes they actually require more integrated costs than planned. One of the reasons of this is the lack of robust cyber risk management practices. This statement is particularly applicable to the correct choice and application of robust IT-security management tools when providing the consulting services. This article considers a case of a cyber-security system implementation. A well-known consulting company was involved in the implementation of this project. The provided examples illustrate the choice of IT-security metrics and the use of various IT-security management tools when providing consulting services in a Holding companies.

articleTitle: Ethical and Legal Principles of Publishing Open Source Dual-Purpose Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In today's world there is an active introduction of artificial intelligence technologies in various fields of science and technology. On the one hand, the publication by open source researchers of their achievements can be called the force for progress. On the other hand, some studies have a dual purpose like the analysis of computer traffic using machine learning methods. A number of questions arise regarding the ethical side of the issue of publishing such information in the public domain. The paper discusses the ethical and legal foundations of publishing open source dual-purpose machine learning algorithms. And also the problems associated with it.

articleTitle: Problems and Opportunities of Using LMS Moodle before and during COVID-19 Quarantine: Opinion of Teachers and Students
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Before the spread of coronavirus infection (COVID-19), LMS Moodle was used by universities as an alternative and additional tool to support the educational process. It demonstrated low effectiveness, primarily because of its episodic use by teachers and students. Mass transition to distance learning in the conditions of self-isolation has led to the increased demand for the platform, but at the same time, it has revealed the obvious problems of using this resource. The article provides the data from an opinion study about the problems of using LMS Moodle conducted among university professors and students. It also presents the results of a correlation analysis of factors that affect the satisfaction of the LMS Mobile consumer audience. The complications of using LMS Moodle that arose prior to COVID-19 pandemic are analyzed and some suggestions for improving the platform are offered in the article.

Author Keywords: interaction of participants in the educational process

articleTitle: Technological Safety Management of Electrotechnical Companies Production Activities
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The authors of the article identified socioeconomic and environmental criterions for technological safety of production activities of enterprises in the electrotechnical industry. The stability parameters of electrotechnical companies are formed. A model of technological safety management based on the basis of identified safety criterions and the Zwicky cube has been developed. Based on the morphological model, an algorithm for ensuring technological safety of the electrotechnical industry enterprises is proposed, taking into account the classification of its levels, formed stability parameters and risk assessment using the Delphi method.

articleTitle: The Prospects for the Creation of a Digital Quality Management System DQMS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of digital technologies can give a new impetus to the development of quality management (QM). The development of new approaches based on the integration of quality management methods and digital technologies creates prerequisites for the digital transformation of the entire product lifecycle. The difficulty of creating an effective quality management system using digital technologies is not only in the absence of specialists in two areas of knowledge simultaneously, but also in the lack of integration of modern quality management methods with existing software products. In most ready-made solutions, quality management is limited to controlling process parameters and product quality. Automatic registration of process parameters with real-time data analysis should be additionally enabled in DQMS. This will allow you to organize monitoring and control of processes at each automated workplace. The accumulated analysis results will help you make decisions in difficult situations. A set of processes with digital control and analysis ensures quality assurance at all stages of the product lifecycle.

articleTitle: Development of Automation Systems for the Unified Duty Dispatch Service “System-112” in Order to Increase Efficiency Activities in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: we studied aspects of increasing the efficiency of the functioning of the single emergency service of protecting the population and territories through the use of a complex of automation tools. A comparative description of three systems of software and hardware systems from different developers was carried out. Recommendations on their use were given. The basic requirements and the structure of the technical means of their complex of automation tools, as well as the directions for further improvement of the complex of automation tools for the single emergency service“ System-112” are determined.

Author Keywords: parameters that determine the structure of a single emergency service and a set of automation tools

articleTitle: Model of a Monitoring System for Academic Performance and the Issuance of Diplomas Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays, verification of the diploma and monitoring student academic performance has become a burning issue. This is ongoing process that starts from the moment a student enters a university and ends with diploma issue, with the ability to further verify their accuracy. This article describes the model for monitoring student performance and the issuance of diplomas using blockchain technology, its elements and structure, process diplomas release, the possibility of further verification of diplomas and student grades.

articleTitle: Development of Algorithms of Automated Products Quality Control System in Technological Processes of Machining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Quality of products in technological processes of machining significantly depends on the control level and automation. In its turn, the degree of automation is defined by a number of automated control function and management. Defining the controlling functional relations and development of the relations based algorithms for automated product quality control is a topical and important from the point of view of practice problem. The research work observes the issues of the control of tools machining processes by edge tool. It offers the examples of the problems solutions of the optimal control of lathe work and milling in one step at random allowance change. On the example of drilling, we observed the types of machining when a tool wear rate and cutting-force change even at unchanging parameters of cutting rate. The results of the research work can be used when developing the automated products quality control systems in technological processes of machining.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies for Monitoring Product Quality and Safety
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: At high-tech companies, primarily aerospace, developed modern methods of quality management using information technology. The development of the digital economy has shown the need to implement such methods in other industries. But even the best products can lose their properties at other stages of the life cycle - storage, transportation, etc. In aviation, standards for maintenance and quality assurance, which can be used for other facilities, have long been developed. This study provides recommendations for the provision and monitoring of quality by the example of medical devices using information technology.

articleTitle: Digitalization of Quality Management of the Strategic Decision-Making Process
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Strategic decisions are linked to long-term goals and priorities. At the same time, current trends point to an increasing dynamics of ongoing events that affect these priorities. To improve the quality of the decisions made, we propose to add a tactical loop that is able to track changes in events in a relatively short period of time to a system with a strategic management loop. To improve the quality of the relevant strategic decisions, we propose to use the block for analyzing big data, reflecting the state of the control object. The dynamics of the process is provided by intelligent analysis of the digital twin of the control object. Application of the approach under consideration relates to the field of strategic decision making as an additional solver.

articleTitle: On-line Education Resources for the Optimization of On-line Continuing Professional Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The study aims to analyze the possibilities and limitations of on-line and off-line education resources for continuing professional education. The analysis of online education resources was carried out in terms of learners' age, qualifications and needs. The definition of the concept of online continuing professional education was given and its characteristics were singled out. Types of on-line and off-line education resources were systematized according to the components of educational process: to provide education content (virtual educational platforms, video creation kits) and different types of education and pedagogic interaction (cloud-based video conferencing services, collaborative tools); to stimulate and control the learning activities (online quiz makers). The experience of online continuing professional education was analyzed. The challenges for learners of different categories were identified. Recommendations were developed to optimize the use of online education resources for continuing professional education.

articleTitle: Development of Automated Quality Control and Management Systems at Industrial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with automated quality control and management systems used in the production process. Industry specifics are taking into account. The stages of the production process at the furniture enterprises on which quality is mainly lost are examined. Solution to these problems is proposed. It is the introduction of digital visual quality control systems. Measures for the implementation of visual quality control systems at enterprises are evaluated by the investment level.

articleTitle: Security Assessment Process of IT-components for Cloud Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays, the attention has increased significantly on the IT-components security, including the assessment of multiple types of objects using cloud infrastructure. The article discusses the opinions of Russian and foreign experts on a wide range of issues of IT-security as stand-alone IT-components and holistic cloud services. The article proposes a practical approach based on the “Hybrid” methodology using formal assessment procedures based on two cardinalities of criteria: the assessment of management systems compliance degree (based on ISO/IEC 27001 series) and the assessment of functional safety requirements (based on IEC 61508 series and ISO/IEC 15408 series). The proposed method allows to obtain the traceability results of IT-security risk assessment of cloud IT-components in the given constraints. Sufficient and correctly implemented countermeasures minimize the risk (residual risk) for significant assets. These results can be applied to the processes of an independent assessment, including critical infrastructure, with the required accuracy of calculation.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Modeling of Technogenic Safety on Electrotechnical Industry Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article identifies technogenic risks in the enterprises of the electrical industry, as well as analyzes the methods of their assessment. Based on information about the occurrence of emergency and emergency technogenic situations using Spearman's rank correlation, a matrix of relationships between risk events is constructed. A method for reducing the risks of technogenic safety is proposed, taking into account economic, environmental and social factors.

articleTitle: Information Technologies in the Management of Digital Marketing Communications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper considers the conceptual issues of IT integrating into the management of digital marketing communications. The issues of the traditional cycle implementation of management of digital marketing communications in the software products form that ensure end-to-end analytics, events to promote goods in the digital sphere, virtual goods presentation, consumer engagement on various digital platforms are explored. The IT classification depending on their application in the management functions of digital marketing communications is presented. In terms of solving analytical problems in the management of digital marketing communications, there has been made the comparative analysis of relevant information technologies, such as BI systems, CRM and MRM systems, Internet statistics systems (GoogleAnalytics, Liveinternet, SpyLog, Ya. Metrika), marketing automatic analysis programs: “BEST-marketing”, “MarketingMix”, “KonSi”, and the Marketing Analytic software complex. The possibilities of using Big Data technologies to control communication flows and determine the effectiveness of digital marketing communications at different stages of the purchasing decision process are described. The factor model of calculating the profit as a result of media prosumers' activities on various digital platforms using Big Data technologies is presented.

articleTitle: The Safe Solutions System Modeling in a Digital Technology Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the implementation of an integrated system of environmental management. The authors `research has shown that digital transformation sets the vector of innovation activity of the enterprise, but makes the enterprise vulnerable to external factors and threats. The authors model a decision-making system under conditions of uncertainty and risk. The proposed approach to implementing an intelligent safe solution provides powerful data visualization capabilities and allows you to make decisions based on data.

articleTitle: Modeling the Digital Twins of Transport Infrastructure Objects
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The model of a digital twin of a production site suggested in the article using information modeling technologies that allows to accumulate information about the site and the features of its operation in a single information database, helps to quickly solve technical issues and incidents that may arise during the operation of the site (this may be leaks, interruptions in power supply, malfunctioning of various systems, including ventilation, fire, etc.), which, of course, will have a positive effect on the reputation of the developer and the reputation of the organization using the machine.

articleTitle: Creation of Digital Archives of Design Documents
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses ways to create digital archives of design documentation for various source versions, such as ready-made drawings on paper, often with graphics damage, inaccuracies and/or errors. A method for controlling the accuracy of a digital model based on a physical product is proposed, even if the object is difficult to measure manually. Due to the proposed method, it is possible to determine the accuracy of the resulting digital model and the possibility of applying the resulting design documentation(digital model) for use in modern production using advanced processing technologies.

articleTitle: An Algebra-Logical Approach to Modeling of Complex Systems Control Problems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: We consider an algebraic approach to the description of modeling methods, in which the generation of structures with different types of logical calculus is based on the use of the concept of “valuation” as a morphism from a set of formulas in the structure, which takes the value of their truth. This allows us to consider the set of formulas of the algebra of logic with the equivalence relation introduced on it as a factor-algebra with a certain structure. The results of modeling of non-classical formal-logical systems, new, generalized formulations of generally recognized rules of inference are presented. The principal novelty of the proposed approach lies in the fact that it opens the way to the formation of a unified formal base of methods for modeling control problems. It is of general significance for modeling problems, since it allows not only to expand the capabilities of methods for modeling control problems, but also forms a methodological base for studying the relationship between them.

articleTitle: Android Software for Testing in Audio and 2D User Interaction Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Software has been developed that implements a digital form of remote knowledge control in Java for the Android platform. The testing system uses visual, audio and graphic generation of questions and answers, which ensures the use of traditional forms of training in remote mode. In addition to the offline mode, an automatic testing system suggests the possibility of a network interaction between a teacher and a group of students. An example of an automatic system for remote assessment of musical literacy of students of music colleges is given.

articleTitle: Guidance Accuracy of Aerial Vehicles in Accordance with Edge Earth Surface
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Basing on the theory of distinction of statistical hypotheses an algorithm was developed in the work for processing of the data on the terrain relief for the definition of deviations in the trajectory of the aerial vehicle flight from the prescribed direction. Estimation of the effect of geophysical data processing on the accuracy of correction for the trajectory of aerial vehicle was performed. The requirements to the minimum amount of data were determined that provided the needed accuracy in the trajectory correction.

articleTitle: Non-conforming Products Management in a Digital Quality Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article addresses the issue of changes in the quality management system, with the digitalization of the company. More specifically, changes regarding the process of managing non-conforming products. The article reflects how the use of digital tools and new technologies affects the process of detecting non-conformities and how the procedure for working with non-conforming products changes: how is the collection of data on the characteristics of the facility, what decisions need to be made regarding the inconsistencies, how the structure of work with non-conformances is changing and to what extent the use of information tools is beneficial.

articleTitle: The Digital Information Competence of an Individual: Historical Aspect
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article is devoted to analyses of the digital information competence. The article presents the positions of scientists on this problem. The components of the specialists' information competence are distinguished. In the article, the relevance of new information technologies is described in the unified educational and information space. The reasons for expanding the digital literacy and the appeal to the digital competence are determined. It is noted that the responsibility as a component of the digital competence requires the knowledge of the rules in the digital world. Four types of the digital competences are defined: information and media competence; communicative, technical, consumer competences. Particular attention is paid to the motivational component, which is related to the security of modern information and communication technologies for studying youth.

articleTitle: Bilding the Dashboard to Monitor and Analyze Data when Forecasting Risks in Integrated Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The rapidly evolving digitalization of the population encourage the Company to seek an effective response based on dynamically changing needs. Progressive managers solving this problem, carry out the digitalization of business processes. However, it is difficult to build the right “digital facade”, relying on outdated “analog” business processes. The authors described the approach to building process model based on BPM and the ISO 9001, ISO 14000 standard and determining the criteria for the business processes effectiveness. The visualization of data on the effectiveness and sustainability is given. The Dashboard is constructed with Power Query and DAX language with the necessary set of commands for building visualized and advanced functionality. A study of customer satisfaction was conducted, the NPS index was calculated. The most significant risks of reducing customer satisfaction are expressed and ranked by probability and degree of influence.

articleTitle: Software Infrastructure Management Systems for Smart Territories
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the development of a mathematical model for managing subsystems for the life support of a residential building. The results of the selection and justification of a multi-level management structure are presented. The results of the analysis, selection of parameters of the cascade control system are presented. Analysis of the subject area of the interaction of infrastructure objects by categories: smart territory → smart city → smart home has been performed. A context diagram and precedent diagrams, decompositions of a system for assessing the physical deterioration of systems of engineering equipment of a smart home have been developed. The goals and objectives of the project development are formed and the main requirements for the designed software application are highlighted. The simulation of typical life support structures in the CX-Programmer environment was carried out and a virtual object control program was developed in the language of ladder diagrams (relay-contact circuits). Cascade (adaptive) control at a real facility within the framework of the Smart City strategy is justified.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition Using YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There was developed a system within this study that recognizes traffic signs on video. This system uses the YOLOv3 convolutional neural network architecture. The maximum accuracy of recognition of road signs reached 93.91% per 1000 iterations and 99.94% per 2000 iterations.

articleTitle: Approaches and Problems to Assessing Readiness for the Implementation of Modern Digital Technologies in a Quality Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Implementing digital transformation in an enterprise is a complex process. The basis for forming recommendations on digital transformation and increasing enterprise readiness for digitalization is an approach that involves the identification of three enlarged stages, each of which determines the answer to one key question: stage No. 1 - why to transform; stage number 2 - what to transform; stage number 3 - how to transform. This article analyzes the main problems that companies and their quality management systems face in the process of introducing modern digital technologies, as well as tools for preliminary diagnostics of the company's readiness for such transformations. A comparative analysis of the models for its assessment was carried out, according to the results of which five integrated assessment areas were identified: strategy and business model, consumers, organizational culture and personnel, operational processes and information technologies.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Human-Machine Interface for Controlling a Robotic Manipulator Using Gestures
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article dedicated to human-machine interfaces. The principles of a non-contact human-machine interface with the possibility of intuitive control of mechatronic robotic complexes using hand gestures are described. A pressing problem today is the algorithm for starting the operation of contactless position determination systems in tasks when the robot directly repeats the movements of the operator's hand. A method is described for determining the moment of the start of work by introducing an additional control channel using the coordinate displacement algorithm, which avoids unwanted movements of the controlled system. An algorithm for shifting the coordinates of the controlled system using the state of the pedal of the beginning of work is developed, a structural diagram of the principle is proposed. The proposed principle was tested using a non-contact optical system to determine the coordinates of human hands.

articleTitle: Problems of Implementing Information Security Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: To date, the issue of security of information system resources in the presence of threats in the global information sphere is one of the most urgent both in Russia and in the world. This is due to stricter requirements for companies that store and process personal data. Recently, more and more companies of large and medium-sized businesses regularly face the resolution of incidents related to data loss as a result of cyber attacks or violation of established information security regulations by the company's personnel. In this regard, priority attention to information security has become a necessity for running a successful business. An information security management system — ISMS) is a part of an organization's overall management system based on a risk-based approach to managing information security. SMIB allows not only to minimize the risks associated with information security, but also can give a serious competitive advantage in the global market.

articleTitle: System Approach in Mathematical Support of Modeling Methods in Quality Management Problems of Complex Systems and Processes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article raises the problem of the formation of a common base of mathematical modelling of the tasks of quality management systems and processes of a complex nature. Analysis of the problems that arise in the mathematical modeling of control problems of objects of great complexity shows the systematization of modeling methods is possible through the use of the concept of synthetic qualimetry. The significance of the proposed approach is determined by the fact that synthetic qualimetry is based on the synthesis of existing measurement theories. This makes it possible to carry out a systematic analysis of modeling methods and the choice of mathematical structures for objects of different nature within the framework of special qualimetry. This determines the novelty of the proposed approach. Identifies ways to build a common base of the formal description of the process of control of complex objects and processes.

articleTitle: Application of the Neural Networks for Cryptographic Information Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The object of research is information security. The tools used for research are artificial neural networks. The goal is to increase the cryptography security. The problems are: the big volume of information, the expenses for neural networks design and training. It is offered to use the neural network for the cryptographic transformation of information.

articleTitle: Interaction of the Dirac Electron Located in a Potential Well with a Plane Wave Field
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Relativistic physics is the physics of high speeds and energies. The interaction of relativistic particles in the general case does not preserve the rest mass, therefore, the processes of birth, annihilation, and interconversion of particles be-come possible. So, in nucleon collisions, π-mesons are born, the electron and positron, annihilating, turn into γ-quanta. The electric field surrounding a charged particle is the result of the continuous production and absorption of virtual photons. The Schrödinger equation does not describe the possibility of the creation and destruction of particles; moreover, its Hamiltonian corresponds to nonrelativistic classical mechanics. All this means that the Schrödinger equation is valid only in the nonrelativistic field of motion and is not applicable in the relativistic one. This leads to the need to replace the Schrödinger equation relativistically in-variant equation for an electron, Dirac equation. The main task of the relativistic theory is to calculate the probabilities of transitions (scattering cross sections) in a system of free microparticles before and after the interaction, that is, in calculating the result of the interaction. This problem is solved on the basis of non-stationary perturbation theory methods.

articleTitle: Liveness Detection Mechanisms to Enhance Robustness of Authentication Methods in Game-Based Educational Services
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Security of modern game-based educational services highly depends on applied identification and authentication technologies. Since main issue for developers of such systems is user suitability (ergonomics of software), this fact has repeatedly led to problems with user identification/authentication. Neglect of additional information protection mechanisms, such as two-factor authentication or preliminary checks, and insufficient control over the correctness of embedding these mechanisms in educational services is dangerous not only for the educational services themselves, but also for the university information systems, on which they are deployed. The article describes mechanisms for enhancing the reliability of game-based educational service and focuses on usage of liveness detection method for voice identification/user authentication. Examples of implementation for educational systems, which do not require additional equipment, are presented. Reliability of proposed liveness detection mechanism was tested, including some of identified ways to bypass voice identification/authentication technologies. This research could be basis both for development of new robustness game-based educational services and for improvement of current information protection mechanisms.

articleTitle: The Integration Platform for Project and Operational Management of Enterprise Business Processes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Success of a modern enterprise is determined by the quality of business processes development which requires the integration of various information systems. Developed mechanisms of production system management should also be included in a single environment in accordance with business processes. Absence of a platform for effective management of production processes seriously undermines the potential of the enterprise, even in the presence of high-quality business process development. Project and operational enterprise management is a very promising mechanism of production system management. Project and operational enterprise management allows to carry out modeling, analysis, correction, distribution, control, etc. on an operative scale of time.

articleTitle: Approach to Construction of Common Information Space of Manufacturing Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The development of methodology and support tools of the design process and practical implementation of the manufacturing enterprise common information space (CIS) is considered. The proposed methodology allows top management, analysts, developers and IT specialists to respond quickly to changing organizational and technical conditions of production and impact of the external environment, to clarify and agree on requirements to elements of the enterprise control system, to continuously improve and modernize the CIS during the operation of the enterprise. It is shown that the application of existing methodologies and notations is not enough to ensure consistency at each level of CIS design with the corresponding program documents: business development strategy, functional strategies (including information technology development strategy, digital transformation strategy, etc.), project description and technical tasks for software and hardware development, etc. The proposed methodology involves using IDEF0 notation at the top level with decomposition and business process modeling in BPMN or eEPC notations at the middle level. For modeling and software development at the lower level it is proposed to use flexible development methodologies - the agile methods based on the use of corresponding models: user stories, abstract UML models, block diagrams. The advantages and peculiarities of practical application of the proposed methodology in the design of the CIS and elements of the production executive system of the manufacturing enterprise are considered.

articleTitle: System Analysis of Transport-Information Infrastructure Transformation in Modern Cities
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern cities develop quite rapidly. Some of them decided to forbid cars at all, and the others expands autobahns and parking spaces. However, there are several trends in modern cities development, that join all of them. Vast majority of the trends covers transport-information infrastructure. There are more static infographic information tables and more tables with data, that changes each several minutes. The paper is dedicated to analysis of transport-information infrastructure transformation in modern cities.

articleTitle: Application for Recognition of Road Transport Using TensorFlow
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The use of intelligent transport systems gives us an opportunity to solve the issues of reducing traffic jams, improving road safety and increasing energy efficiency. There was developed a system within this study that detects and classifies the vehicles on a video obtained from the intersection surveillance cameras. The presented system uses the SORT algorithm to track objects on video and a neural network architecture Mask R-CNN to recognize and classify objects on the video frames. The developed system allows to classify cars into 10 categories. And the accuracy of objects recognition reached 79%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Parameters of Optical Linear Displacement Transducer with Open Channel
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article describes the structure and principle of operation of the optical linear displacement sensor with open optical channel. Scope of application in industrial equipment for measuring vibration parameters is determined. Analysis of errors caused by external illumination of the optical channel and a change in the reflection coefficient of the object surface is accomplished. Methods of reducing errors are considered. Recommendations about the use of transducer as part of information and measurement systems are provided.

articleTitle: Information Interaction in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problem of managing a network with increasing flow of tasks that require dedicated network resources is shown. Several versions of solving the problem are given. A mathematical model is presented for calculating the total bandwidth of communication channels of network structures designed for solving the incoming tasks. An example of calculations of the model is given. The results can be useful for users and network system administrators.

articleTitle: Development of Automated Control and Information Systems for the Technical Operation of Level Crossings
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article provides a preliminary analysis of possible technical solutions for the automated control of speed at level crossings based on the technologies of control and information systems and satellite navigation with the possible involvement of a minimum number of motion sensors at the level crossing from the highway.

articleTitle: The Theory of Gravity and the Combination of Gravity with Electromagnetism Based on Cartan Mechanics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper, the theory of electrogravity connectivity is formulated in the framework of the mechanics of E. Cartan. In addition, the Fokker-Planck equation for the probability density is obtained. For the curvature of space-time, this should have a definite meaning. A stationary solution of the Fokker-Planck equation for the curvature of space-time is obtained. And we studied the partition of 5-dimensional space into 4-dimensional layers of different space-times, whose different geometry is created by different T <inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">αβ</inf>. A generalization of the general theory of relativity is formulated in the language of mechanics of E. Cartan. The Hilbert-Einstein equation with a fluctuating source is obtained. An equivalent Fokker-Planck equation is obtained which is stationary in X<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> and gives a 4-dimensional Riemann-Einstein space-time, which fluctuates during the transition from one 4-dimensional cross-section of 5-dimensional space to another. A generalization of this scheme leads to the appearance in various sections of the 5-dimensional space of various electromagnetic and gravitational fields, which are combined into a single electrogravity interaction, as was shown in the previous works of the authors. In various sections various laws of such interaction are formulated.

articleTitle: Accreditation of Engineering Degree Programs: What is New?
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper highlights changes and recommendations to the procedures of engineering degree programs accreditation to be accounted by accreditation agencies and Higher Education Institutions due to covid-19 pandemia and restrictions at universities caused by it.

articleTitle: Modeling SMART Technology Mobility of Students for Open Education System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article represents the process of the Smart-Technology model development to automate decision-making in the field of educational mobility organization for open education system. The novelty is that for the first time SMART-technologies are considered as an integrated IT-environment with the common interface for making optimal decisions when students make their own choice of route, content, travel mode, accommodation, meals, etc. The practical importance of the study is that the system of open education is enriched with the new opportunity for mobile learning.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Instrument-Computer System for the Diagnostics of Atherosclerosis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Computer modeling is an actual direction in the development of medical diagnostic and treatment systems. We developed an instrument-computer analyzer algorithm for noninvasive diagnostics of atherosclerosis based on the correlation of systemic hemodynamics and lipid metabolism. A computer program was compiled. Mathematical regression formulas were obtained for calculating the biochemical parameters of atherosclerosis - the level of cholesterol in the blood and its fractions. The automatic analyzer includes functional blocks for measuring blood pressure parameters and monitoring the patient's excess body weight, and the control microcontroller calculates blood cholesterol levels in accordance with the application program. With the help of signaling devices, a UART transceiver - interface and a USB / UART converter, an efficient transmission of indicators is provided on the instrument display, communication with the base computer of the system, analysis of the results and creation of a database. Relative error of calculation is not more than 15-20%.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Technology as a Solution of the Resource Assignment Spread Issue in Research and Development Projects
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper describes the issue of quality control and management in the field of non-threaded form of aircraft production. Frequently, many enterprise projects are executed at the same time. These projects use shared resources and it tends to increase the role of project planning in the field of quality management. The main aim of project planning system is to maintain a steady resource assignment spread with a compliance of a contract terms. It occurs two issues. The first issue is to perform the project scheduling and the second one is to identify and evaluate risks. A reasonable approach to tackle these issues is to involve the machine learning technology to solve a problem that occurs from cross influence of projects. Suggested method will probably increase accuracy and distance of project scheduling that acts on production quality improvement. In addition, produced regression function can be used to identify and evaluate risks.

articleTitle: Receiving and Decoding Receiver Information of Global Satellite Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The areas using of satellite navigation systems are expanding and currently cover aviation, navigation, rail and road transport, geodesy and cartography, geodynamics and seismology, military affairs, astronautics, agriculture, communication systems and telecommunications. The article presents an example of obtaining and decoding information from a receiver of global navigation satellite systems - U-blox GY-NEO. The receiver can be used as an embedded module in the development of systems for various purposes.

articleTitle: Simulation of Nonlinear Dynamic Circuits by Means of Matlab
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the application of mathematical modeling of dynamic circuits with a nonlinear transformer. The analytical solution of such a task is accompanied by complex mathematical calculations. In this case, the simulation of the electrical circuit allows to simplify the analysis procedure, reduce the calculation time, visualize schedules and considering alternative conditions for a task. The simulation is carried out with the help of the Simscape library in the MatLab system.

articleTitle: The Problems of Design and Application of Switching Neural Networks in Creation of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The new switching architecture of the neural networks was proposed. The switching neural networks consist of the neurons and the switchers. The goal is to reduce expenses on the artificial neural network design and training. For realization of complex models, algorithms and methods of management the neural networks of the big size are required. The number of the interconnection links “everyone with everyone” grows with the number of neurons. The training of big neural networks requires the resources of supercomputers. Time of training of neural networks also depends on the number of neurons in the network. Switching neural networks are divided into fragments connected by the switchers. Training of switcher neuron network is provided by fragments. On the basis of switching neural networks the devices of associative memory were designed with the number of neurons comparable to the human brain.

articleTitle: Risk Management in Running ERP-based Process Model of Integrated Group of Companies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper analyzes the task of setting up and running management system that is based on digital ERP process model that works for the integrated group of companies which includes several legal entities physically located in different geographical areas. The solution design is based on a process model that includes local and cross-functional processes and regulates the interaction of management structures within a distributed object. The process model digitalization potential is analyzed with a risk-oriented approach. The structure of the corporate management project is developed on the basis of the ERP-II “Enterprise Resource and Relationship Processing” concept using “1C: ERP Enterprise management” software and risks assessment methods.

articleTitle: Creation of Integrated Quality Systems for Standard Solutions of It Infrastructure Organization, Information Security of the Construction Complex at the Stage of the Real Estate Object Life Cycle (Construction Stage)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article considers the improvement of management mechanisms for the main integrated business processes of construction complex enterprises at the stage of the real estate object life cycle (construction stage), including IT-systems, information security management Systems and risk management Systems. Methodology and methods for designing and creating an ISM.

articleTitle: Information Technology in Product Development by Method of Quality Function Deployment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Development of modern management methods, introduction of information technologies in the business processes of the organization is one of the main components of its effective performance. The article shows the advantages of developing a new product/service using the methodology of the quality function deployment and also considers the use of information technology to improve the efficiency of processes involved in development.

articleTitle: Complex Modeling of Physically Inhomogeneous Processes in the Problem of Increasing the Reliability of Radio-Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The authors propose a new method for increasing the reliability of radio-electronic equipment, which involves obtaining deterministic reserves for thermal and associated electrical and mechanical loads of electrical components. These reserves should be used as additional indicators for calculating probabilistic reliability indicators at enterprises. The currently used method of calculating using only probabilistic laws of quantities distribution is not subject to practicale verification in tests. Many of the values used in calculations are averaged. The authors show that the use of real coefficients of electrical, thermal and mechanical loads in the reliability analysis of electric components will give a real effect, because developers will be able to avoid violating the modes of their use. Using the latest advances in information technologies in the field of physical processes modeling with the requirement to take into account the relationship of these processes with each other will increase the reliability of the designed radio-electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Teaching English for Specific Purposes to Future Programmers on the Moscow Area Digital College Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper describes the content of the English for Specific Purposes (ESP) electronic learning pack developed by the author for college students majoring in Information systems and programming and published on the interactive platform “Moscow Area Digital College”, the system of exercises for language and communicative competence development, and some issues on using the learning pack on the Moscow Area Digital College platform. The thematic content of the learning pack covers both the specializations the speciality “Information Systems and Programming” comprises and Worldskills competencies related to this speciality. The system of exercises includes lexis and grammar training, reading texts and performing the tasks for speech skills development. The learning pack shows college students different professions in the field of information technology and facilitates a certain flexibility in the labour market formation. The learning pack is student-friendly, and it proved its usefulness for college students.

articleTitle: Socio-communication Problems of Distance Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Russian higher education, under the influence of globalization and the need for integration into the global scientific community, is faced with such problems as preservation quality of information flows (fundamental education), training a creative specialist, and the problem of an effective organizational form of education. Distance education as an opportunity to gain knowledge has existed for a very long time and there has always been a dismissive distrust of them in universities. However, directly or indirectly, the crisis caused stakeholders of education, as the most massive part of the world's population, to the necessity of making and testing distance forms of learning and communication to the full extent. The study analyzed the opinions of students about the possibilities and limitations of online learning, the degree of trust in the learning outcomes, and the quality and applicability of gain knowledge. The sociopsychological conditions for completing educational programs are also evaluated.

articleTitle: Forecasting Technical and Economic Indicators of Cyber-Physical Systems' Design Solutions Using Foresight Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Cyber-physical systems enable to connect physical processes with electronic-software systems for continuous management realization. They become an integral part of the modern digital economy. Projects of cyber-physical systems design and management are central to innovative development of enterprises and industries. In current conditions of dynamically changing external environment, cyber-physical systems' project management require a proactive approach. At the initial stage, design decisions are developed considering various influencing factors and possible scenarios of the project evolution due to the Foresight modeling method. This article is devoted to one of the key aspects of the development and implementation of design solutions for cyber-physical systems - the forecasting of technical and economic indicators. Prediction capabilities using Foresight modeling as the foundation of proactive management are considered.

articleTitle: Smart System for Detecting Unauthorized Entry into a Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article covers the matter of the risk assessment of unauthorized entry into a smart home. Thereby the authors model and compare two approaches to the issue considered. The first technique actualizes a fuzzy system for the level detecting intrusion danger and warns about an unauthorized entry. But the second technique deals with a neuro-fuzzy system construction for assessing the level of unauthorized entry to the smart home. The authors present a structure and methods of training fuzzy and neuro-fuzzy systems to evaluate the level of unauthorized entry to the smart home. They carry out a series of experiments on the models of the designed systems. According to the results of comparative analysis, the authors recognize the application feasibility of a neuro-fuzzy system to assess the level of unauthorized entry to a smart home with a fuzzy logic inference algorithm based on Takagi Sugeno fuzzy model. Besides, the authors run a neuro-fuzzy system computer modelling/simulation to identify its best values. In particular, they declare a list of the best membership functions for generating input linguistic variables. They also propose a hybrid learning technique and the method of linear coefficients for developing terms of the output variable/signal.

articleTitle: Information Security in the Management of Personnel in a Modern Organization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Social and managerial mechanisms in ensuring information security are one of the most relevant issues, both in theory and in practice. Therefore, the chosen research direction is timely and necessary in the period of rapid development of information and logistics technologies for enterprise management. Study of the basic and original approaches to information security and logistics services of companies in different industries, the analysis and systematization of the author's points of view on the issue of security in business objects (economic security of motor transport enterprises, security of the supply chain, international security) resulted, in our opinion, some solutions to the problems posed in the article title.Information security is defined as the degree to which information and its processing tools are protected, integrated, and available to the public.

articleTitle: The Impact of Internet Socialization on Changing the Professional and Value Orientations of Young People
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The Internet is forming a new space of socialization, that contributes to a change in professional and value orientations of youth. The article addresses the cause-and-effect relations of changes in professional and value orientations of young people in the context of Internet socialization. The results of Internet users' surveys conducted by the authors over the past two decades are analyzed in the article.

articleTitle: Development of an Integrated Control System Model for Engineering Education Based on Quality Control and Lean Production Technologies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes managing the processes of an engineering educational organization as managing a holistic entity through the characteristics of the value stream. At the same time, the value stream is an activity aimed at creating the value for customer, such as engineers, which is implemented through a system of interconnected processes/operations. The article demonstrates the possibilities of integrating the modern models, standards, methods and tools for quality control and lean production into the processes of an engineering educational organization in order to achieve the aims of engineering education taking into account the requirements of engineers and other interested parties. Integrated control system model for engineering education based on quality control technologies and lean production tools is presented.

articleTitle: Prospects for the Optimization of Parabolic Antenna Reflectors for K and Ka Frequency Bands
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Increasing frequencies of perspective space mirror antennas functioning leads to a significant tightening of the requirements for the accuracy and stability of the reflecting surface of the used reflectors, however, the provision of high requirements is technically difficult to implement. Hence, the problem of Pareto-optimal design of parabolic antenna reflectors with a relatively high signal amplification coefficient and minimum requirements to the accuracy of the reflecting surface profile is formulated. Analytical estimates have been obtained for Pareto fronts of various ranks, characterizing the accuracy of the profile of the reflecting surface of the antenna parabolic reflector depending on its diameter and the range of operating frequencies required to ensure a relatively high signal gain.

Author Keywords: accuracy of the reflecting surface profile

articleTitle: Digital Platforms and Applications for “Online and Offline Copyrighting” Discipline in On-Line Education Format
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article continues our analysis of “Online and offline copyrighting” discipline transformation from traditional offline education format to E-Learning in Saint-Petersburg Electrotechnical university “LETI”. The 2019 polling discovered that students lack offline communication with the lecturer, thus it was decided to introduce a mixed format in 2020. Due to COVID-19 outbreak all the lecturers and students had to change the mixed format to a distant one. The focus is made on the comparative study of students expectations and feedbacks after the introduction of E-Learning (by using different digital platforms and applications - open.etu.ru, Zoom, Discord, Big Blue Button, Skype) and offline education format. The research embraced 105 students and 5 lecturers.

articleTitle: The Method of Spatial-Temporal Analysis of Various Oscillational Modes in the EEG Brain Activity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the present work, we show the application of new technique for spatio-temporal analysis of EEG data. The developed technique is based on the modification of the classical approach to the analysis of EEG data with the division of the whole wave activity into frequency ranges with using of continuous wavelet transform. This technique was used to assess the activity of the subject's brain in the process of increasing fatigue during prolonged exposure to monotonous cognitive load in test subjects evening after working day. Applying the developed mathematical tool to the experimental data, we demonstrate the emergence of various scenarios of the fatigue in test subjects.

articleTitle: Online Education for Engineers - Myth or Reality?
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the experience of teaching a number of disciplines to students of engineering specialties using distance learning methods. It is believed that such disciplines as descriptive geometry, resistance of materials, physics, electrical engineering, strength calculations, etc. cannot be converted to online format. The article provides examples of online teaching descriptive geometry, physics, work in BIM programs, numerical methods for calculating building structures to future design engineers and civil engineers at the Russian University of Transport. The problems and prospects of such a teaching method are considered.

articleTitle: Modeling of Contact Interference Appearance in Cyber-Physical Systems of On-Board Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The results of the study of the phenomenon of formation of contact electromagnetic interference to radio reception, presented in the article, are of great importance for the design process of on-board electronic equipment. The resulting contact radio interference is the result of the interaction of radiated electromagnetic waves with dynamically changing contact resistances of structural elements of moving objects. With this phenomenon, secondary radiation of structural elements is formed, which significantly expands the spectrum of emissions of transmitters mounted on moving objects under the influence of electromagnetic radiation from a transmitter on conductive mechanical contacts. This phenomenon leads to the formation of secondary radiation by structural elements, which significantly reduces the electromagnetic environment at the facility. In the presented materials, the mechanism of formation of spurious contact noise is studied by the example of the study of nonlinear models of contact pairs that create expanding spectra of electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Promising Digital Solutions for the Efficient Technological and Managerial Processes on Transport
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The use of artificial intelligence systems is a trend both in global digital transformations and in the digital transformation strategy of Russian Railways. The development of information systems that improve the dynamics and efficiency of technological and managerial processes in transport will reduce the inter-train intervals subject to traffic safety, automate technological operations, and implement an unmanned driving system; it will also increase the efficiency of the use of transport infrastructure by increasing the routing of transportation, increase the productivity of both the dispatching and the personnel planning the transportation process, reduce a significant number of redundant information systems with duplicate functionality, as well as reduce the impact of the human factor in making managerial decisions in the face of increasing workloads and quality of services provided. The technological need for digitalization of technological and managerial processes is associated with the requirements to increase the efficiency and quality of operations on the railway network under infrastructural constraints and structural changes in cargo flows in the country, especially in the direction of the ports of the Far East.

articleTitle: Management of Innovations and Knowledge in the Structure of the Enterprise Integrated Information Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper analyzes the possibility of implementing knowledge and innovation management activities in the structure of the invariant part of CALS (Continuous Acquisition and Lifecycle Support) technologies. A practice-oriented approach to introducing knowledge and innovation management activities into the integrated information environment of the enterprise is proposed.

articleTitle: Modeling the Structures of Threats to Information Security Risks based on a Fuzzy Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: the article deals with the development and implementation of a method for synthesizing structures of threats and risks to information security based on a fuzzy approach. We consider a method for modeling threat structures based on structural abstractions: aggregation, generalization, and Association. It is shown that the considered forms of structural abstractions allow implementing the processes of Ascending and Descending inheritance. characteristics of the threats. A database of fuzzy rules based on procedural abstractions has been developed and implemented in the fuzzy logic tool environment Fussy Logic.

articleTitle: Using Network Cooperation Opportunities in E-Learning for Future Technical Specialists
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Features of network cooperation in e-learning for technical specialists defined by their major, developed competences, future professional activity are revealed in this paper. Interdepartmental and intradepartmental forms of network cooperation of students are characterized: practical-oriented (dual) training in the conditions of cluster cooperation with enterprises-social partners of the educational organization; organization of work between teachers from different departments based on the interdisciplinary approach to the educational process. A specific electronic means of network cooperation is developed: an electronic educational and methodical complex created on the basis of training and production facilities together with employers, which suggests completing an electronic interdisciplinary task. An electronic information and education environment is developed which functions on the basis of several synchronized information resources of an educational organization using cloud based technologies. The efficiency of electronic network training is assessed according to the revealed criteria of interdepartmental electronic cooperation in the network training of students.

Author Keywords: interdepartmental and intra-departmental forms of cooperation

articleTitle: Telecommunication Networks Security as a Part of Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Cybersecurity is extremely important nowadays. Many objects, such as banks, airports, big supermarket and gas stations can be under hacker attack every day. Therefore, their internal cybersecurity, that is based on telecommunication network security is so important. There are three main types of system that protects telecommunication networks: firewalls, sandboxes and antivirus programs. Each of them persuades their own purpose and important for cybersecurity. In this paper, they will be discussed from quality management point of view.

articleTitle: Development of the Concept of the Quality Profile of Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article examines the current quality issues of mobile applications, in terms of research on the theoretical foundations, main trends and problems in this area. The concept of a hierarchical model of the quality of a mobile application (MA) is being developed, and the metric approach to the task of managing the quality of MA is also investigated. The methodological issues of the systemic organization of the quality profile of MA are considered, with the aim of determining and forming a universal and open for further development set of basic quality requirements for mobile applications, as well as with the aim of harmonizing, at the stage of the life cycle, relations.

articleTitle: Information Modeling of the Process of Providing Orthopedic Dentistry Services
