publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the problem of the subjectivity of the process of providing prosthetic dentistry services and reduction of its quality at high prices. The ways of resolving the contradiction within the framework of creating an information model of prosthetic dentistry services are proposed. The model differs from the existing ones including additional steps. These steps allow to control the quality of each step's technological process as well as their order and resource cost. These results can be achieved when you include information data on single prices for each step noting the qualification of the specialist. The constructed model will allow to automate the process of quality management of prosthetic dentistry products. Building the information model is done in notation IDEF0. Indicators are used to monitor the time taken to complete the stages of the services performance and the manufacturing of products in this healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of Engineering Education Based on a Fractice-Oriented Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article provides a comparative analysis of CDIO and the Federal State Educational Standard in the field of training “Mechatronics and Robotics”. The planned learning outcomes are formulated on the basis of combining the requirements of the two standards and the directions of modernization and development of the educational program are indicated by incorporating the universal components of CDIO into the program: interdisciplinary design work; development of personal qualities; communication skills; professional knowledge of information technology.

articleTitle: Self-drive Parking Quality Assurance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In modern world self-driving car is not a unique thing. There are a lot of companies that produce these systems. Self-driving parking assistant is or can be included almost in each modern car. However, they are still not very popular nowadays. Why is it so? Which prevents our life and traffic from self-driving parking daily usage? In this paper, aspects of self-drive parking quality assurance are discussed. As a result, the paper summarizes the issues that prevent from daily usage. Moreover, it finds out how self-driving car parking centers can help do handle some or vast majority of these issues.

articleTitle: Adaptive Safe and Energy-Efficient Driving Control of Unmanned Rail Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In the field of developing unmanned vehicles of almost all types, in the area of providing the driving control system with measurement information, most attention is nowadays paid to the development of specialized computer vision systems. That notwithstanding, in this work, a broader view of the problem of removing the driver from the control loop is proposed. Indeed, in addition to visual information, he has following data sources at his disposal: sensation of shocks, vibrations and oscillations of the car's body; sensing accelerations during speedup, slowdown and passage of curved sections; hearing noises, creaks, wheels rattling, etc. Using the entirety of the information available to the traditional human driver requires a deep study of interactions in the “moving object - motion environment” system (including the influence of the changing load and the displacement of the center of mass); selecting appropriate sensor hardware; and accommodating for these interactions in the algorithmic support.

articleTitle: What Should be Done to Improve Smart House Systems Quality?
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Smart house systems are quite coon nowadays. They are produced by many companies, including the simplest in implementation by Huawei and Xiaomi and up to specialized systems. The paper covers the main quality issues of smart house systems, current data and results. The main idea of the paper is to suggest some ideas about quality of the systems improvement. Currently, the main issue is that the systems are for all customers in some groups and they have to be more diversified according to consumers' needs and expectations.

articleTitle: Software Implementation of Algorithms in Jet Grouting Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays, the problem of fixing soils in construction is very relevant. Jet grouting is one of the most effective methods of soil stabilization. This injection method allows you to create a geotechnical screen and significantly reduce the subsidence of the base. This technology is widely used both in Russia and abroad due to economic, environmental feasibility and technical efficiency. This article describes the algorithm the automation of the design process when the technological strengthening of soil grouting piles in the tunnel about space. On the basis of the developed algorithm was created by the application software for AutoCAD system, which is usually developed project documentation.

articleTitle: The Development of Pedagogical Thinking of Students Through the Use of Information and Communication Technologies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper considers the problem of the formation of pedagogical thinking of students, future teachers. The process of perceiving a problem situation and formulating a pedagogical task is analyzed. The possibilities of information and communication technologies in the implementation of the acmeological approach to the development of pedagogical thinking are considered. The results of a study of the formation of pedagogical thinking in students based on the use of information and communication technologies are presented.

articleTitle: Analytical Online Technologies for Assessing the Readiness of University Management to Effectively Use Social Capital
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes the purpose, development process and results of using online technologies to assess the readiness of university leaders to effectively use social capital. A lot of works, which described the impact of social capital on the effectiveness of higher education institutions are devoted to the description of tools for evaluating effectiveness. As a rule, these studies illustrate the principles of empirical analysis of social capital in a real educational institution. In Russian universities, the culture of building and effectively using social capital is not developed. Also, many managers are not ready to effectively use the existing potential of social capital in everyday activity of the university. For assessing this readiness we offer the use of online technologies that are accessible and easy to use. Online instrument allows to evaluate the results independently and prepare data for be processed.

Author Keywords: online technologies for measuring the effectiveness of social capital management

articleTitle: Automated Control System for Electrical Equipment in Production
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article defines the role of an automated control and management system of electrical equipment in production, studies main types of such systems, their requirements and key benefits. The main part of electric installation work when using remote control systems for electrical equipment is determined.

articleTitle: Creating a Multi-Agent Information-Analytical System for Implementing Domain-Specific Search for Information
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Structures, algorithms, mathematical models and methods for forming multi-agent data search and analysis systems are proposed. The capabilities of systems using the multi-agent architecture are shown, which allow carrying out a more efficient analysis and problem-oriented information retrieval on the Internet as well as providing the user with various data and documents relevant to a given problem. In the proposed model, the search setting does not depend on a specific search system and is general, and in the format of the setting module it is possible to refine the settings for a separate search system. Keeping the settings of the communication standard between agents, it is quite easy to replace any node, add or remove, so you can get an easily modifiable and flexible system without changing the architecture of the system as a whole.

articleTitle: Electronic Educational Resource in the Discipline «Information Technologies in Ecology»
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the use of electronic educational resources in the modern educational process. The article gives the principles of the development of electronic educational resources and their qualification. The article analyzes such problems of modern education as the lack of participation of a certain part educational institutions in innovative development and the information space of society, as well as the insufficient use of modern educational technologies. An example of the creation and use of an electronic educational re-source in the study of the discipline “Information technology in ecology” is examined.

articleTitle: The Automated Control System Technological Process in Control Efficiency and Quality Treatment for Tool in Plasma Generator Glow-Discharge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Questions are considered improvement of effectiveness and quality of management developed technological process on the basis of control and parameter estimation processing stages tool in plasma generator glow-discharge. The proposed approach enables choose the most effective management technologies at all stages high-speed processing tools taking into account their optimization. An automated control system has been developed taking into account the complex structure of internal ties in glow-discharge when processing tools

articleTitle: Information Security Methods' Application Based on the Digital Management Approaches and the Deming Cycle in Improving the Modern Production's Processes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The implementation of the characteristics of modern production of a new generation is impossible without the digital control and information security introduction. Integrated control management tools provide correct solutions by creating electronic models in the production systems and complexes design. The article shows that the improvement of modern production parameters and characteristics is implemented based on the following requirements: information security systems; using digital management approaches; introducing the modernized Deming PDCA quality management cycle. It is also shown how risk accounting helps to avoid systems and processes inconsistencies.

articleTitle: Region Environmental Safety under the Electrical Industry Influence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Currently, one of the most important problems facing humanity are energy and environmental problems (largely caused by environmental pollution). The article describes the theoretical aspects of environmental safety in the region, taking into account the influence of the electrical industry. Based on the study of scientific literature, definitions of such concepts as the electrical industry and environmental safety are given. The problems of environmental safety in the electrical industry are revealed. The main directions of measures to ensure the environmental safety of the region are described, as well as the system of actions that must be performed to ensure a stable state of environmental protection due to the influence of the electrical industry. Technogenic and biospheric concepts of environmental safety under the influence of the electrical industry are considered, according to which the system of measures for environmental protection is determined.

articleTitle: Modal Tests of Machine Structures. Comparative Analysis of Tow Indentification Methods in Frequensy Domain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Methods for identification modal parameters of machines are based on experimental modal analysis. On the example of a single test model the set of amplitude-frequency characteristics of conditional mechanical systems, two algorithms are considered: direct parametric identification and approximation of the frequency characteristic. The first algorithm that implements batch mode is based on the theory of mathematical programming. The second algorithm is based on a heuristic approach, using modal segmentation methods and implementing an interactive mode. Both algorithms give good and quite comparable results in terms of approximation accuracy, but they have their own peculiarities. Methods can be effectively used both individually and together.

articleTitle: Automation the Processes of Informing the Population of the Metropolis about the Epidemic Situation Taking into Account Information Security Requirements
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Modern society faced the global pandemic problem. But besides the direct fight against the virus consisting in the quarantine regime application and in the health system improvement, rational population informing methods are also needed to counter panic. The article is devoted to development the automation system of informing the metropolis population about the current epidemic situation. During the design process special attention was paid to information security aspects. The personal data protection mechanism is presented in the article.

articleTitle: The Study of the Degree of Spatial Synchronization in EEG Activity in the Perception of Visual Stimuli
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In this paper we present the results of the study of the development of various synchronous regimes in the spatial EEG activity of the brain for the subjects during prolonged monotonous load. During this experiment, the subjects briefly observed visual stimuli that they recognized by pressing the remote buttons. Further we evaluated the test subject's response to stimuli and at the same time a mathematical analysis of EEG brain activity. To assess the degree of synchronization between EEG channels, we modified the technique based on wavelet bicoherence math method. The paper establishes the features of the occurrence of synchronization in different frequency ranges between EEG channels, depending on the nature of the presented stimulus and the reaction time of the subject to the stimulus. Statistical estimates of the mathematical analysis of experimental studies for patients of various genders are presented.

articleTitle: Improving the Prospective Design of Mining Based on the Promotion Modern Software and Hardware and Technical Means of Monitoring and Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: New approaches to mining engineering are needed in the context of growing volumes of mining and processing of poor hard-to-recover, poorly studied ores and increasing volumes of mining of overburden massifs that are variable in strength and structural properties. The transition to modern information technologies of mining planning, using block models of deposits, is one of the ways to improve the efficiency of design and planning of mining operations. At the same time, the process of creating and filling a block model with objective data on the structural and strength properties of overburden rock massifs is a big problem for mining companies. As the development of mining technology mapping of rocks on the basis of the advance of modern hardware and software, equipment monitoring and control using intelligent complexes drilling rig - excavator is a source of timely and reliable data, the replenishment of block model fields used in the of mining works design.

Author Keywords: zoning of the explosive robotization of the processes of mining

articleTitle: Information Management at Different Stages of Human Society Development
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses the stages of historical development of information transmission methods. The main types and means of signal transmission used at different stages of human society development are highlighted. The place and role of information transmission in modern conditions, the degree of their impact on human, social groups and society as a whole. The characteristic is given and the impact of information exchange on the development of social structure and the formation of the information society is evaluated. The peculiarities of increasing the sustainability of the development of modern human society using the analysis of the socio-historical experience are characterized.

articleTitle: Using Photodiodes and Inductive Sensors in the Automated Control System and Management Quality when Processing Tools in a Glow Discharge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Questions are considered improvement of effectiveness control of the plasma generator glow discharge based on inclusion in the control system photodiodes and induction sensors for ensuring the necessary quality processing tools. The proposed approach allows implement for the most effective operational management fast-moving processes, flowing in plasma glow discharge taking into account their optimization. Developed by an additional device for the control system, allowing for the complex structure of internal links in glow discharge when processing tools.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Technologies in Project Training for University Students
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Under conditions of digitalization of economy the issues of information and communication technology use are of great importance in teaching university students. Allowing combining the diverse areas of human activity reflected in the disciplines of the educational process, method of project-based learning is gaining wide recognition. This helps us consider the problem of integration in educational process through the toolkit of project-based learning, knowledge and skills in the sphere of information and communication technologies and the subject area of students' training. The authors of the paper actualize the problems of conformity of the university software products used in the process of university management, learning process to the requirements of fast-paced processes of economy digitalization. There have been developed some recommendations on the use of software products with the help of project-based learning method.

articleTitle: The Neural Network Model for Assessment and Forecasting of Level of Infectious Incidence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The neural network model was developed for assessment and forecasting of level of infectious incidence. Basic data for forecasting are: map of the area; data on the calls to doctors in the area; the number of the diseased during the set time. The output data are the results of monitoring of the current situation of incidence on the area and the forecast of incidence for the set time period. The neural network model has the special structure of the multi layers. For modeling of incidence in the megalopolis where are certain areas, the neural network breaks into fragments which then were connected by the switchers. Each fragment models incidence in the certain area.

articleTitle: Influence of Information and Communication Technologies on Formation of Social Capital of the University
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Empirical studies of social capital s a significant factor in improving the efficiency of Universities are very important for development of higher education. However, the practical measurement of the University's social capital and the evaluation of its impact on effectiveness is challenging. This paper discusses the problems of designing a theoretical model, measurement and analysis of the social capital of the University. This study presents the results of a pilot research aimed at developing the methodology and tools for measuring and analyzing the University's social capital. Qualitative and quantitative methods of analysis were adopted for this study. The units of analysis included teachers, Departments and Institutes of the University. The results of the study showed that empirical researches of the impact of social capital on the professional activities of University teachers is associated with a large number of factors, which requires the development of special algorithms and information systems for efficiency management based on the use of social capital.

articleTitle: Improving the Hardware-Software Complex for the Scheelite-Containing Ores Research on the Effectiveness of Lump RGB Sorting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Reserves of rich deposits are rapidly being dwindling. Involvement in the mining and processing of poor, hard-to-concentrate ores requires new approaches to preliminary ore sorting of mineral raw materials. A common photometric separation method needs to be with developed using modern automation tools. The most difficult problem is conducting research on a composite ore. In particular, processing the results of lump studies is a very time-consuming process. It is necessary to justify not only separation signs, but also their rational meanings. This requires automation, especially when justifying the parameters of a technology with many re-sorting. The work proposes a new hardware-software complex for scheelite-containing ores research on the effectiveness of lump RGB sorting.

Author Keywords: ore quality management technology at the mining stage
photometric method for registering useful lumps
automation of the process mapping of technogenic formations
hardware and software complex for lump RGB studies

articleTitle: The Advanced Tools for Data Processing from Fibre-Optic Instrument Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper presents a range of measures that broaden the tools of algebraic data processing from fibre-optic measuring lines. The authors propose and study the method for parametric identification of attributes of measuring lines. This method allows improving the accuracy of data restoration by means of individual technical and technological factors typical for the measuring lines and making additional errors into the mathematical model of the measuring system. In addition, the authors comment on two methods: reduction of the projection matrix, which makes it possible to reduce the dimension of the underdetermined projection matrix in a number of special cases and the rating method for the veracity of data reconstructing result.

articleTitle: The Organization of Information Protection at the Object of Informatization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article is dedicated to modelling the information security system of an object of informatization. The main directions of information protection, as well as the main stages of its implementation, are presented and described.

articleTitle: Measurement and Quality Control of a Nanomodified Surface Layer of Machine Parts
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Research into the possibility of defect structure management, and measurement and quality control of a nanomodified surface layer of machine parts are the key goals of surface engineering. The first part of the problem was previously solved by cavitation technology using nanomodified coolant in turbine blade finishing. An attempt to solve the second part of the problem concerning measurement and quality control of a nanomodified surface of turbine blades has been made in this paper. Surface roughness and microhardness have been controlled while measuring. A methodology for estimating the specific number of microcracks, being an additional parameter for assessing quality of the surface layer of machine parts, has also been developed. Surface roughness was measured using SEYTRONIC PSH8-4 profilograph-profilometer, and microhardness of the sample surface was measured using HMV-G21DT tester. The number of microcracks per unit surface area was estimated using VEGA3 TESCAN scanning electron microscope at 921x magnification. Application of the developed control technique allowed obtaining quantitative assessment of nanomodifiers in surface treatment of machine parts. Experimental research has revealed that due to filling microcracks with chromium nanoparticles using cavitation, and grinding of the part, surface roughness Ra decreases by 11%, surface microhardness increases by 7%, and the specific number of surface microcracks decreases by more than 30%. A comparative analysis of the root-mean-square values of roughness, microhardness, and number of surface microcracks has revealed that using of nanomodified coolant in grinding leads to a decrease in these values by 7%, 10%, and 10%, respectively, which indicates improved repeatability.

articleTitle: Information Security of Logistics Services
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Information security of logistics services. Information security of logistics services is understood as a complex activity aimed at using information and means of its processing in order to increase the level of protection and normal functioning of the object's information environment. At the same time the main recommendations for ensuring information security of logistics processes include: logistics support of processes for ensuring the security of information flows of the enterprise; assessment of the quality and reliability of elements, reliability and efficiency of obtaining information about the state of logistics processes. However, it is possible to assess the level of information security within the organization's controlled part of the supply chain through levels and indicators. In this case, there are four levels and elements of information security of supply chains.

articleTitle: Description of Fermions Interacting with Two Calibration Fields Based on Cartan Mechanics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Here traditional quantum mechanics was used and the probability of scattering and absorption of photons by the fermion system was calculated. Today it is already clear that the theory of color or nuclear interaction can be constructed by analogy with the electro-weak interaction, which describes the electromagnetic and weak interaction of elementary particles. For this purpose, quantum field theory can be used. In this paper, the interaction of fermions with 2 gauge fields is described on the basis of the mechanic E. Cartan. The dynamics of fermions and gauge fields is also described. The Hilbert-Einstein equations for the gravitational field are also formulated. On this basis, a mathematical model of the Big Bang is proposed - the transformation of inflaton into a system of particles and antiparticles, and their annihilation with heating of the remaining particles.

articleTitle: Highly Integrated Compact Motion Control System for Brushless DC Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The Brushless DC (BLDC) machines are becoming a very popular in drive technology over the last years because of its advantages including low maintenance, high power density, high efficiency and robustness compared to other type of motors. Because of its numerous advantages the BLDC motors can be found in different applications, such as vehicle and home appliances. Over the last decade, low power, low cost and high torque BLDC machines have gained popularity in robotic applications, replacing stepper and brushed motors in servo drives. Commonly used BLDC motor control systems have poor efficiency and poor dynamic response or requires external position sensor that increases the cost, weight and reduces reliability. Developed highly integrated hardware, driven by custom, resource-saving control algorithm offers precise position and torque control, as well as rotation smoothness even at close to zero speeds that makes it well-suitable for robotic manipulators, interacting with fragile objects.

articleTitle: Selecting the Adequate Probability Density Model of a Signal Reflected from a Spatially Distributed Object
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article addresses the problem of selecting the probability density models for signals reflected from spatially distributed radar objects. It is shown that the models selected are in good agreement with experimental results.

articleTitle: On-line Course in English Medium Instruction for Academic Staff
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In times of digitization and internationalization of tertiary education the demand for academic staff able to deliver English Medium Instruction (EMI) courses is unprecedented. However, the literature on hands-on practices in EMI lecturer training is scarce and the forced immersion in distance learning causes to find new ways to acquire skills in EMI. To fill in the gap, the author offers a variant of an online EMI lecturer training course, describes the most efficient online forms of collaborative learning and provides the analysis of the experience of 25 trainees from the 2019/2020 academic year. Semi-structured interviews show that EMI lecturers encounter difficulties of psychological, methodological, linguistic and technology-based character. All the lecturers notice that the greatest challenge is the appropriate technology-enhanced teaching for international students in a remote teaching model. The findings of this study can be useful for developing online courses as part of CPD for academic staff.

articleTitle: Implementing Distance Technologies in the Educational Process of the Master's Program
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article presents the results of analysing the problems that arise in the process of training in a Master's program in one group of students, both with and without basic education in the major of the Master's program. Teaching options are offered for groups of undergraduates with different levels of basic knowledge in major subjects, based on the experience of teaching undergraduates at the Technological University. As the main method, we offer additional distance learning for undergraduates which aims at forming the basic knowledge necessary for the quality masters training.

articleTitle: Modeling the Magnetization Curve of DC Machines in MATLAB Simulink
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The features of modeling DC machines in MATLAB Simulink are considered. It is shown that in this simulation environment there is no possibility of taking into account the nonlinear magnetization curve of the machine and the presence of residual magnetic flux. The possibility of modeling and obtaining the correct characteristics of DC machines in MATLAB Simulink by making changes to the library block of an additional function is considered. The analysis of the applied methods of approximation of nonlinear dependencies is given and their disadvantages are indicated. A method has been developed for specifying a non-linear magnetization curve of a direct current machine and finding its analytical dependence without carrying out their full electromagnetic calculation using only passport (catalog) data.

articleTitle: Features of the Application of the Millimeter Wave Range in Mechatronic Systems for Remote Monitoring of Natural Hazards
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Mechatronic systems for remote monitoring of such dangerous natural phenomena as thunderstorms and hail clouds are based on radar research methods. The features of using the millimeter wavelength range for studying the microstructure of thunderstorm and hail clouds are shown. A mathematical model of the scattering of millimeter-wave electromagnetic waves by various cloud particles has been developed.

articleTitle: Model of Intelligent System for Quality Evaluation of Services on Design Stage (Transport and Logistic Business as an Example)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The authors propose a model for assessing the quality of the designed services at the early stages of their life cycle. The model integrates the qualitative and quantitative indicators of the future service and includes the forecasted needs of consumers, based on which one can assess their potential demand and competitiveness by the criterion of price / quality ratio. The proposed model has two distinctive features. Firstly, forecasting customer requirements for the quality of services is based on the results of machine learning on data of existing and potential customers, as well as based on the accumulated knowledge base of consumer experience and expert opinions. Secondly, the model involves multi-criteria optimization, while some of the optimized parameters are discrete or qualitative (verbal, non-digital, non-measureable). In conclusion, the authors demonstrated the advantages of the developed model by the examples of the transport and logistics business in the field of passenger and freight transportation in Russia.

Author Keywords: Early Stage of the Service's Life Cycle

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches for the Oil Well Reserves Evaluation Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This paper studies the application of machine learning methods to allocate oil resources in the strata. To solve the problem, different algorithms of machine learning were analyzed and trained on borehole logging measurements: K-nearest neighbors, Random forest and Gradient boosting.

articleTitle: To the Strategy of Training an Engineer in Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article argues that quality management refers to a new type of engineering, which is emerging and developing in the context of post-classical science, focused on interdisciplinarity, transdisciplinarity, human-dimensional systems and the synthesis of knowledge, bringing to life technology science, technology convergence, as well as new types and forms of engineering. In this situation, the synthesis and integration of natural science, social and humanitarian and technical knowledge becomes a reality for engineering, which is especially pronounced in the engineering profile “quality management”, requiring accounting for the training of an engineer of this profile in practice.

articleTitle: Investigation of Trees Algorithms for Improving Quality of Client's Data in Data Mining Tasks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Machine learning methods, which are tree-based algorithms, have found their application in the task of improving the quality of client data. Among such methods are distinguished: decision trees and decision forests, random trees, ensembles of trees and forests. Such methods are used both to save large amounts of data from redundant information, to restore missing values and to determine anomalous values. Subsequently, on the data transformed by such algorithms, it is possible to build highly accurate forecasts of changes in the target parameter, whether it is the size of profit or investment. Thus, the effectiveness of applying algorithms on trees in a new field for the introduction of machine learning is proved.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Adjusting the Machining Modes of Anisotropic Materials
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: This article discusses the problems of machining anisotropic materials associated with the choice of the direction of cut relative to the fibers of the material. The use of a processing mode that is invariant with respect to the direction of the fibers causes a decrease in surface quality and premature wear of the tool used. The use of an additional feedback channel, by which it is possible to determine the current direction of the fibers of the material, can allow to adjust the processing mode in real time. Studies of the dependence of the torque of the milling machine spindle on the direction of the fibers of the processed anisotropic material are carried out. Based on the described principle and research, a block diagram and an algorithm for the operation of the control system that implement the correction of the processing mode of the material are proposed.

articleTitle: The Relationship between the Functionality and Consumer Properties of Online Courses: Evaluation by Users (Students)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: E-learning occupies an increasingly important place in the global education system. Ensuring its accessibility and quality is one of the most important tasks of digital engineering; that is why domestic and international standards, fundamental works and practical methods are used to solve it. However, the design of online courses has trouble integrating efforts of developers, designers, marketers, administrators, teachers, who must work together in order to add value to the educational product for the ultimate consumer. Cumulative opinion of students obtained by the pools' results can serve as a feedback tool for the design and organization of online learning. Focus on the value that online courses can provide for users will help determine the direction of development and optimization of the most functional and useful from the point of view of the consumer system performance. The article presents the results of study aimed at investigating the factors that have a significant impact on students' satisfaction with online learning. Using a model of success D & M IS can predict the behavior of students, enrich the knowledge of information systems training and provide a framework for action for the improvement of university management system in the transition to distance learning.

articleTitle: Computerized Solution Verification Systems Applied for On-Line Programming Training
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The purpose of the article is to study the potential of automated solution verification systems for training Programming online. The automated solution verification is based on a system for developing a virtual machine/container that allows isolating the process of checking the program code within a time limit and with a memory limit available without compromising the security or stability of the installed system. To test the effectiveness of the research the authors organized the Python language training by using the developed system for teaching programming Steach.Space and the R programming language by using the online learning system Stepik. The authors found out that the use of automated solution verification systems can increase the effectiveness of online programming training. The research results show that the improvement rate was 29 per cent in the experimental group and only 17 per cent in the control group.

articleTitle: Methodology for Creating, Implementing and System Effectiveness Evaluation of the Business Processes' Information Security System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses creating aspects of an information security management system, business processes using various tools and mechanisms. The authors proposed requirements for an information security management system (ISMS), including a general methodology for creating, implementing and evaluating the effectiveness of ISMS mechanisms. Two of the most well-known standards for the implementation of ISMS are considered, namely ISO / IEC 27001: 2013 and ISO / IEC 27005: 2018. Currently, there is an increased interest in these standards from organizations working in various industries. Compliance with it becomes an important factor in the commercial success of the company due to a number of advantages that it receives. A process approach to build the ISMS and risk management based on these standards is applied.

articleTitle: Development of a Software Library for Game Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Today, technologies of artificial neural networks are very popular and are used in various fields and tasks, such as pattern recognition, classification. To create artificial neural networks, constructors or software libraries for machine learning can be used. However, they do not always contain the necessary functions. In some cases, you need to write your own software library to solve non-standard tasks. The article discusses the development of a software library for creating artificial neural networks. Using the developed library is demonstrated in the task of implementing the game artificial intelligence of the opponent in a simple computer game “Tic-tac-toe”. The effectiveness of the opponent's game is compared with the implementations of opponents based on the minimax algorithm and the random behavior algorithm.

articleTitle: Calculation of Evoked Potentials from EEG Data Using Time Delays
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article shows how to use the time delays to increase the accuracy of the calculation of evoked potentials according to the EEG brain data when the subjects perform simple movements. The advantages and disadvantages of this approach are shown. The resulting time delays for individual events can be used to subjects analyze.

articleTitle: On-line Continuing Education for the Development of Faculty Academic Mobility
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: We investigated the effectiveness of on-line education for the development of faculty academic mobility. The barriers to academic mobility development were revealed in a preliminary qualitative study of 272 members of academic staff. To overcome these barriers we worked out the information system consisting of two components: managerial and development ones. To implement the system two environments were created: the first one is the information environment (website) that provides up-to-date information on the mobility programs and educational modules to create individual learning trajectories for the faculty; the second one is an online education environment created using digital platform for online education (Moodle) to organize distant and blended learning and support self-education and self-control. The experimental results showed a significant increase of 37% in academic mobility in the control group (50 members of academic staff) in comparison with a random group (58 members of academic staff).

articleTitle: What is Mobile Operation System Quality?
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: There are some modern mobile operation systems. The main two of them are iOS and Android. However, in the past, there were two more commonly used ones: Windows Mobile and Symbian. Each of these systems has its own pros and cons, whereas none of them is the best or the worst one in different criterions. In this paper the main criterions of operation system quality are discussed. The paper defines what the mobile operating system quality is.

articleTitle: Purposeful Project and Operations Management Environment for the Small-scale Production
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The problems of forming a purposeful environment of the design and operational management system for a small-scale production are considered. Small-scale production is characterized by a wide range of manufactured products and difficulties in predicting the terms when the manufacturing of these products will start. The consecutive analysis of the current production situation, as well as formation and adjustment of parameters of the design-production system its improvement allow in a dynamic mode to form decisions which would improve technical and economic indicators of projects which create a new technology.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Process of Urban Infrastructure Management with Implementation of the Concept of «Smart City»
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The given article is dedicated to the research and application of «Smart City» concept to the urban governance of Taganrog. The various aspects of the research subject have been considered and examined, such as: theoretical background of «Smart city» concept; foreign experience of «Smart city» development and performance; and legal regulations and restriction on implementation of «Smart city» technologies in Russia. Moreover, forecast indicators have been analyzed to take into account the current decisions on urban governance of Taganrog while further applying the program of sustainable city development locally. The informational and technological tools for optimization of the city life have been studied by conducting the interviews among the Taganrog residents and local authorities. In conclusion, the «Smart city» model of urban governance optimization applicable both to Taganrog and rest of Russian cities has been developed based on implementation of digital communication and IP technologies.

articleTitle: System of Automated Support for Information Decisions of the Designer when Designing Technological Equipment from Normalized Parts in a Computer Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: What needs to be done to transfer knowledge from normative resources (NR) accumulated from the time of the USSR to the computer form and how will the designer work efficiency parameters change? The answers to these questions are, in fact, the subject of this article. As an example of transferring knowledge to a computer environment, we use NR to design molds for injection molding of plastics. We define the computer environment for the design of technological equipment from normalized parts as a system of automated support for information decisions (SAPIR/NR).

Author Keywords: representation of activity and design of technological equipment

articleTitle: Scientometric Knowledge and Tools in Modern Information Web Space
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: In recent years, modern problems of scientometrics have become one of the most actual topics of discussion, both among the scientific community and among government representatives in the field of science and education. The reason is the introduction into scientific reality of a system for assessment the effectiveness of Russian researchers. Accordingly, competent coverage in the information space of the development and application of scientometry requires fundamentally new communication approaches. In this scientific article, the authors analyze methods in promoting scientometric knowledge in the Russian-language information web space and identify the most effective ones.

articleTitle: Reengineering of Technical Quality Management System For Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article discusses product quality management issues for intelligent transport systems, as well as defines the role of the quality management system in the overall management system in the enterprise. With the help of the software complex, strategic planning, enterprise processes were automated with the definition and consolidation of performers and key indicators, generation of regulatory documentation, monitoring of processes, mandatory documented procedures.

articleTitle: Development of Material Grade and Thickness Control System for Abrasive Waterjet Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the issues of improving the quality of abrasive waterjet machining of metals and alloys using CNC equipment. The development and implementation of automated control system for the grade and thickness of the processed material reduces the number of manufactured products of inadequate quality by staged control of workpiece parameters immediately before abrasive waterjet machining. As a result of the study, a block diagram of an automated control system for material grade and thickness and an algorithm for the operation of the automated control system were proposed, and the constituent elements of this system were selected.

articleTitle: The Problem of Automating the Quality Assessment of Mobile Learning by Students
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the problems of automating the assessment of mobile learning from the point of view of students. It is proposed to consider a model based on the assessment of students' reflection in the management of learning from an open education system. Possible criteria for evaluating the relevant process are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of Electricity Supply of the Railway Crossing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The proposed simulation model of power supply for a railway crossing allows you to avoid the main system's flaw in the development of technical solutions for the selection of electrical equipment, allowing automation of safe movement at unguarded and maintenance-free crossings which is the insufficient use of the ability to automatically control the speed of a train approaching the area, including taking into account the current situations at the crossing in case of insufficient power transformers.

articleTitle: Simulation of Tunable Electrical Circuits Using NI ELVIS II Complex
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Tunable passive and active bandpass filters due to their university and flexibility help to simplify designing devices which are applied for various functional purposes. These filters are useful for electronic, information-measuring and control systems, as well as for biomedical, acoustic and hydroacoustic equipment. In this regard, the inclusion of tunable filters in the training course of electrical engineering is very important. The NI ELVIS II complex, applied for measurements, allows studying the characteristics of tunable filters in both the time and frequency domain. The examples of transient processes in tunable passive and active filters of various orders are considered, frequency characteristics obtained with the tools of the NI ELVIS II complex are described.

articleTitle: Development of Hardware and Technical Means of Control and Management for Mining and Technological Research at the Stage of Mining Operations
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: A significant part of the mineral deposits mined by the open pit is represented by rock formations that differ significantly in structural and strength properties. The variability of mining conditions in the development of deposits is a big problem. A hardware-software complex for mining and technological mapping of rock masses is proposed by registering changes in the energy performance of heading and lifting engines. To register changes in the quality of the ledge soles, particle size distribution and shape of the collapse broken mass, the hardware-software complex provides a binding energy performance engine heading, lifting, turning through the position of the bucket in space and time with the operations of the excavation cycle: digging, filling and holding the filled bucket.

articleTitle: Human Precardiac Zone Vibrations Analysis Using Parametric Spectral Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article describes an approach of parametric spectral analysis application in apical seismocardiography using an example of the precardiac zone oscillations analysis. Parameters of individual sections of the cardio cycle can be investigated in detail using the proposed approach, which allows one to form a more accurate diagnostic representation of the heartbeat phases within the cardio cycle. The analysis of changes in the seismocardiographic signals modal composition depending on the position of a person during acquisition carried out. The presence of significant changes in the modal composition of such signals, which can be used as an additional diagnostic criterion, is shown.

articleTitle: Development of a Technique for Automated Control of Actuators of Robotic Systems Subject to Aperiodic Dynamic Loads
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: currently, high-tech manufacturing enterprises are most often faced with the need to increase the level of serial repeatability of manufactured products. The most characteristic factor of production, leading to a violation of the repeatability of products, is the deviation of the modes of performing production operations from the modes assigned by the technological process. The solution to this problem will significantly reduce the duration of the production cycle of products, as well as unify the technological process of their production. The possibility of unifying technological processes within an enterprise or several enterprises, in turn, leads to anincrease in the economic effect of production. This article presents a methodology for the use of automation tools for the most critical stages of production cycles in order to improve the repeatability of technological processes for the production of manufactured products, based on the principle of intelligent control.

articleTitle: Evaluation of IT-security Assurance in a Credit Organization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The paper describes a method for assessing the level of Information security in a credit organization in the Russian Federation and in the World. Given the increasing risks of disrupting the regular functioning of the IT-infrastructure in credit organization, it is important and relevant to consider the problem of obtaining objective and operational numerical estimates of the IT-security level. At present, it is not enough to use only existing static fixed threat models and objectively it is necessary to move to a new assessment methodology based on risk-oriented standards that provide estimates of the effectiveness of the measures taken. The results obtained can be used for evaluating compliance with IT-security requirements for credit organization.

articleTitle: Review of Methods for Ensuring Anonymity and De-Anonymization in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Nowadays a lot of blockchain solutions are presented, in which to some degree implemented methods of anonymization, that allows network participants to hide their operations. Among existing projects, cryptocurrencies stand out: Bytecoin, Monero, Dash, TON (Telegram Open Network), ZCash, Loki, Grin, Beam, Verge, ZCoin, Horizen (ZenCash), BlackCoin, NavCoin, SmartCash, ZeroVert, PIVX, AEON, Fantomcoin and Ring Coin. There are also the privacy enhancing technologies on which they are based: CoinJoin, Mimblewimble, ZK-SNARKs and others. This article studies renowned technologies and methods of de-anonymization and suggests possible directions for further research.

articleTitle: Complex Methodological Approach to Introduction of Modern Telemedicine Technologies into the Healthcare System on Federal, Regional and Municipal Levels
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Regardless of obvious timeliness of telemedicine development, introduction of its results into practice, it faces with a row of problems, in particular: incompatibility of the developed products, applied for different fragments of telemedicine network; incompliance of the variants of telemedicine system development with the standards requirements, protocols specifications accepted in medical diagnostics and the medical information systems; inconsistency of networking equipment for data connection, absence of control and disconnectedness of the fragments at the creation of local networks within the borders of the medical centers. The article suggests the complex methodological approach to the creation of scalable telemedicine system including the solvation of the following tasks: solvation of the issues of implementation of telemedicine system; the choice of the optimal variant of the development of the global telemedicine network on federal, regional and municipal levels with the identification of the peculiarity of each medical center.

articleTitle: Approaches to Building the IT Infrastructure of a Digital Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the issues connected with the transformation of business architecture of the enterprise, connected with the introduction of digital technologies, at all stages of the full life cycle of production of products or services. Additional directions of corporate information systems development, main components of digital directions necessary in the structures of organizations such as data and knowledge management, information technologies and systems management, information security and risk management systems are considered.

articleTitle: Educational Technology Market Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: Last time the educational technology market EdTech has shown significant growth, the dynamics of which exceed the growth of other markets attractive to startups. The article provides an analysis of EdTech market trends, primarily in terms of the development of promising technologies and their application for education and training, including new multimedia, VR, AR, IoT, AI, robotics, gamification, mobile learning, as well as new educational solutions: educational platforms, online educational services and applications, educational games, adaptive educational systems, educational social environments, new devices for learning, new techniques for knowledge evaluation and formative assessment, automation of learning processes, innovative techniques of functional literacy and competencies of the 21st century development, peer to peer learning (P2P), interactive educational projects and so on.

articleTitle: The Essence and Structure of Smart Technology in Mobile Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article analyses the essence of Smart technologies in the context of educational mobility and mobile education. Examples of elements implementation of Smart-cities concepts in China, England, Czech Republic, Finland, Great Britain and Denmark are presented. Smart-technology structure components are revealed. The research has practical value - it allows using the revealed essence and separate elements of Smart-technology structure for realization of particular models in open education system of new generation.

articleTitle: Information and Communication Technology of Getting Future Masters Ready for Scientific Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article explains the necessity to improve the quality of information and communication technologies used to get future masters of technical specialties ready for professional communication in the scientific community. Specific features of information and communication technologies are identified. Based on the information and system approaches, an information and communication technology has been developed to get future masters of technical specialties ready for real and virtual scientific communication. The information model of the technology consists of a set of nodes, communication channels and cycles and serves as part of a complex which is used to study the educational process as a system able to perceive, store and transmit information. The construction of the information model helps the educator to monitor the circulating information and regulate the process. The competitive advantages of the information and communication technology have been identified. The results of testing the technology are presented. The implementation of the models together with the pedagogical conditions according to the step-by-step algorithm shows positive dynamics in levels of future masters' readiness for scientific communication.

articleTitle: The Digital Integrated Environmental Management System in the Electrical Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article deals with the implementation of an integrated system of environmental management. This system will ensure the transition of a traditional enterprise in the electrical industry to a company with a «digital mindset», will provide a path of digital transformation. The authors ‘research is based on the example of the Corporation «ELTEZA». The authors fill the concept of «a digital enterprise» with real content and reveal the essence of specific technologies for each level of system functioning. The proposed approach provides a model of digital transformation for enterprises in the electrical industry.

articleTitle: Methods of Creating an Electronic University
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The main goal of creating an electronic university is the development, production, collection of storage, content delivery and management and administration of the educational process of e- learning. The implementation of e-learning is based on integrated organizational and functional structures, IT infrastructures with their own rules, responsibilities, people, a system of interaction and relationships, i.e. a business structure that flows into the university's business architecture. The paper proposes an approach to the construction of electronic education, which is associated with the development of IT infrastructure of the university, business architecture and process-service approach. The business processes, services, IT infrastructure of the university providing e- learning are considered. The object of the study is the electronic educational environment of the university, which represents the electronic educational environment of the university in the form of services. The term “service” means a service for an educational business, a service that is measured by business indicators, a service that is accessible, continuous and repeatable. The result of the work is a reasonable catalog of university's electronic educational services that can be used as a guide to designing such environments in various educational institutions.

articleTitle: Development of Online-Education Based on the Use of Digital Crowdsourcing Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies (IT&QM&IS)
abstract: The article examines the digital technology for improving the quality of online-education based on the use of crowdsourcing. Crowdsourcing develops innovative online-education based on electronic platforms and communication channels using large-scale educational resources, modern practical activities, flexible and personalized support, more accurate and diverse feedback. The authors substantiate the profitability of crowdsourcing to improve the effectiveness of online-education, form a classification of the main motivations that contribute to the use of crowdsourcing in educational activities, systematize the differences between crowdsourcing and outsourcing. Crowdsourcing is considered as a new opportunity for organizing an online-educational process in order to choose their educational trajectory and reach the planned knowledge, skills, abilities, i.e. the competence of the student. The use of digital crowdsourcing technology in online-education can increase the effectiveness of educational processes and affect the quality of modern education.
